## What changed and why

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results (`ruff check .`, `python -m pytest`, integration tests, manual dictation). Name any engine or setup you could not test.

## Screenshots

For visible UI changes, include before/after screenshots.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes relevant tests or manual verification.
- [ ] User-facing guides and the changelog reflect changed behavior or setup.
- [ ] No API keys, personal recordings or transcripts, logs, models, or build output are included.
